00-cover.png: Project cover: Hadoop high availability with Infrastructure as Code, a reproducible four-VM platform using Vagrant, Ansible, Spark, and Hive.
01-service-placement.png: Service placement across two master VMs and two DataNode VMs, including Hadoop, ZooKeeper, JournalNodes, Hive, and MySQL services.
02-hdfs-yarn-availability.png: HDFS and YARN availability design: active/standby NameNodes, shared JournalNodes, ZooKeeper failover coordination, and redundant ResourceManagers.
03-spark-workloads.png: Spark workloads on YARN: a successful SparkPi run, distributed log aggregation, and a PySpark matrix multiplication example.
04-recorded-router-failover.png: Recorded MySQL primary-failover validation from 27 October 2026: both local Routers reached the replacement writable primary after the original primary stopped.
05-hive-crime-summary.png: Recorded Hive analysis summary for 1,004,894 LAPD crime reports, including area, crime-description, occurrence-year, and data-quality aggregates.
